text: Row filters controlled which rows a user can see. This video adds the other half: masking patient_name and patient_ssn on claims_detail_gold, plus classification tags that make the masking itself auditable.
A SQL function checks compliance_team membership and returns the real value or REDACTED. ALTER COLUMN SET MASK attaches it. ALTER COLUMN SET TAGS marks both columns as PHI.
The mask is a plain CASE expression reusing the same is_account_group_member check the row filter already relies on -- nothing new to provision.
The tag isn't access control -- it's discoverability. system.information_schema.column_tags is the exact query compliance runs every quarter to confirm every PHI column is actually masked.
Tested as both a compliance account and an ordinary one -- rows still filtered by clinic, and now the names and SSNs on them read REDACTED. Next: making the whole pipeline run itself, every night.
